meta.title: Cantek Diagnostics
meta.description: Cold storage diagnostics and repair guidance from Cantek manuals.

footer.description: Industrial cold-chain diagnostic support from authorized Cantek service documents.

home.headline: Describe the problem. Get the procedure from Cantek manuals.
home.subhead: Find relevant guidance from authorized Cantek repair documents. Safety-critical and hazardous work must be handled by qualified personnel.
home.placeholder: Example: cold room not pulling down, HP alarm on a summer afternoon, Octosense controller…
home.empty: Mark the plant and fault on the job sheet, or ask about temperature, alarms, ice, compressors, ammonia, or controllers.
home.disclaimer: Guidance is taken from Cantek documents. It is not a substitute for a certified refrigeration technician. Follow local emergency rules first.

ai.title: Provider connections
ai.description: Configure one or more supported providers. Keys are validated before storage, kept in the private database schema, and never returned to the browser. If one provider is unavailable, the next configured provider is used automatically.
ai.saved: The provider is connected and available for diagnostics.

danger.title: Danger
danger.body: Stop work. Hazardous service requires an authorized, appropriately certified technician using the site-specific procedure.
danger.emergency: Move away from the hazard, evacuate, and call local emergency services and the site emergency team.
